text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One night during the camp. As I walked 
along the beach, listening to the crashing 
waves—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *gasp*! *pant*, *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Emerging from the sea came a dripping 
wet Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Trainer-dono. I was just conducting 
traditional Yaegaki underwater training."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
First... I dive, firmly grip the seabed 
rocks with all ten toes, and assume my 
stance!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Shuffling forward step by step just like 
that, unleashing dozens of basic striking 
techniques! You could call it a kata 
performed in the dark!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Of course, there will be no breaks. For 
whatever reason, if your body surfaces, 
you start over from the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In the terror of darkness, without calmly 
pacing every breath you exhale, completion 
is impossible... Truly, this can be called 
training to the utmost limit.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, one would wear full armor for 
this, but if you can see it through... 
it'll strengthen both your heart and body, 
and surely serve you well in races!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And with that... I'm diving back under! 
Osu!
choice_data_list: ...Then at least put on a safety harness.
...Then at least wear a safety line.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And with that... I'm diving back under! 
Osu!
choice_data_list: ...Then at least put on a safety harness.
...Then at least wear a safety line.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledged! In that case, I will go 
fetch the straw rope at once!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... as I waited, watching the 
occasional spout of water erupting from 
the surface and wondering what kind of 
secret arts were being unleashed down 
there—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Haah! Osu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have achieved it...! I have triumphed! 
We did it, Trainer-dono...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Performing a kata in the dark is truly a 
battle against oneself... It feels as 
though I've come to truly appreciate the 
profound meaning of a "real sword."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Just for this alone, I feel it was worth 
coming here. Thank you so much for 
allowing me to train with you! Osu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was nerve-wracking while waiting, but 
Yaeno Muteki seems to have felt a solid 
sense of achievement!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft-haah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"A blunder...! Did I miscalculate my 
breathing pacing...?!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Once more! I will take on the 
challenge! Next time for sure...!
choice_data_list: L-Let's call it here for this year!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. The next time we visit the 
ocean, without fail...!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Should we stick strictly to 
training that simulates actual races 
during the training camp?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Still... if that's the case, what else 
should we be doing right now? Should we 
head back to the lodge...?
choice_data_list:
If you'd like, wanna go for a little walk 
together?

If you'd like, shall we go for a little 
walk together?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Then allow me to accompany you. 
Indeed, looking at it anew, it is a serene 
and beautiful landscape...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...It reminds me of the words of a martial 
artist. 'Touching upon all arts'... If one 
wishes to master the way of the sword, 
they must also be versed in other arts, 
such as the cultural arts.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, perhaps I shall compose 
a poem about this beautiful scenery as 
well. ............

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"The sea is pretty, the stars are pretty 
too, I'm so happy."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry. Please forget I said that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Afterward, we walked along the beach for 
a while before heading back to the 
training camp lodge."
